name: io.github.nasosal92/df-market-intelligence-mcp
title: DF Market Intelligence
description: Insider trades, prediction-market odds, US macro and x402 data. Pays per call in USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: DF_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding a little USDC on Base (pays per call via x402). Or use DF_WALLET_MNEMONIC.

environmentVariables.name: DF_WALLET_MNEMONIC
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to DF_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY: the wallet's 12/24-word recovery phrase.

environmentVariables.name: DF_SESSION_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Maximum USD to spend per session (default 1.00).

environmentVariables.name: DF_MAX_PRICE_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single call priced above this many USD (default 0.10).
